preconditions.expression: all(line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip())
preconditions.description: Every non-empty line in stdin is a valid string (either an integer T or a lowercase-letter string S).

preconditions.expression: len(stdin.splitlines()) == 1 + T and all(len(S) >= 1 for S in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: The first line is an integer T (1 ≤ T ≤ 5), and each of the next T lines is a non-empty string S of lowercase letters.

postconditions.description: For each string S in the input, stdout contains a line with the integer count of valid insertion positions to make S a palindrome, where count_positions(S) is defined as follows:

count_positions(S) equals the number of possible insertion positions (len(S) + 1) minus the minimum number of mismatched character pairs in S when compared symmetrically from both ends (min_mismatches(S)).

postconditions.expression: min_mismatches(S) == sum(1 for i in range(len(S) // 2) if S[i] != S[len(S) - 1 - i]) + (0 if len(S) % 2 == 0 else 0)
postconditions.description: min_mismatches(S) is the number of mismatched character pairs when comparing S[i] and S[len(S) - 1 - i] for i in 0..(len(S)//2 - 1). For odd-length S, the middle character is ignored.
